items.title: 68427_Harry Edison oral history interview
items.q: when we went to New York... they had another trumpet player named Tad Jones. Tad, Tad Smith... Taddy Smith.

ctx.x: Were you in there when they went to the Grand Terrace?

No, no. That was before. I joined the band in New York. Well, Lips and all of them went in the band in the Grand Terrace. But I -- when we went to New York, Lips got -- you know, he got something going of his own so he left the band. And that's when they got Bobby Moore and then they had another trumpet player named Tad Jones. Tad, Tad Smith --
Tad Smith, I mean. Taddy Smith?
